title: New evidence linking far-right leader Bardella to antisemitic messages revealed

title: How the Trump administration wages its diplomatic offensive against abortion rights
subhead: Since the abrupt halt of USAID, bilateral agreements driven by American interests have replaced humanitarian aid. One of the key provisions is the refusal to fund the promotion or practice of abortion, especially in Africa.

title: Trauma endures in Paris suburb after police grenade shatters teenager's jaw
subhead: On September 28, 14-year-old Eden suffered a fractured jaw and lost most of his teeth after he was struck in the face by a tear-gas grenade fired at close range, just a few meters from his high school, where a protest was taking place. Students, teachers and parents spoke of their fear, anger and sense of helplessness.

title: Heatwaves killed over 8,000 people in France this year. Here are some of their stories
subhead: The French health authorities reported that 8,124 deaths were related to the extreme heatwaves between late May and late August in France. Le Monde spoke to the friends and families of 11 of the victims to find out about the lives behind those numbers.

subhead: From the Paris suburbs to Marseille, as well as Toulouse and Lyon, high schoolers interviewed by Le Monde during the blockades described their study conditions, their concerns and their need to be heard.
